# Selected Non-Communicable Diseases

Chapter 7 covers the **general principles** of NCD epidemiology — shared
behavioural risk factors, WHO STEPS surveillance, and the population vs.
high-risk prevention strategies. This section applies those principles
to three specific diseases in depth, each as its own module.

- **[Module 1: Diabetes Mellitus](ncd/module1_diabetes.qmd)** — burden,
  risk factors, screening, diagnostic criteria, and management principles
- **[Module 2: Hypertension](ncd/module2_hypertension.qmd)** — the
  "silent killer": burden, classification, and prevention
- **[Module 3: Stroke](ncd/module3_stroke.qmd)** — epidemiology and the
  three levels of prevention

Return to [Chronic Non-Communicable Diseases](ncd.qmd) for the general
epidemiology of NCDs, or to [Contents](../intro.qmd) for the full
curriculum.
